estimate.explanation: Dockerfile has 64 lines with 3 layer-creating instructions (RUN/COPY/ADD). Each layer adds build-time memory overhead. Estimated runtime memory: 96 MB, CPU: 120m.

warnings.message: Using latest is prone to errors if the image will ever update. Pin the version explicitly to a release tag

Set the SHELL option -o pipefail before RUN with a pipe in it. If you are using /bin/sh in an alpine image or if your shell is symlinked to busybox then consider explicitly setting your SHELL to /bin/ash, or disable this check
Pin versions in apt get install. Instead of `apt-get install <package>` use `apt-get install <package>=<version>`

suggestions.message: Don't use variables in the printf format string. Use printf '..%s..' "$foo".

securityIssues.suggestion: Review principle of least privilege and immutable tags.
Review principle of least privilege and immutable tags.

securityIssues.message: Container runs as root: no USER instruction in final stage
securityIssues.suggestion: Create a non-privileged user and switch to it with USER before the entrypoint.
